_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: YES BANK Zagg Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: The product page, MITC and KFS publish no reward rate for the current Zagg card. Cards issued before 10 Jan 2025 earned Rio coins; the value of a Rio coin is not stated.

eligibility_engine.notes: Apply in the partner (Zagg) app; the partner may charge a platform fee. Page: age 21 to 60, salaried or self-employed, minimum net salary ₹25,000 a month or ITR of ₹7.5 lakh; existing YES BANK credit cardholders are not eligible.

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: 1% + GST when a transaction is billed in INR at an international location or at an overseas-registered merchant in India (MITC 3(q), KFS)

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% + GST when one fuel transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month fuel spend exceeds ₹25,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(i))
1% + GST on utility and service transactions when the previous calendar month's utility spend exceeded ₹25,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(h))
1% of the transaction (minimum ₹1 up to ₹1,000; minimum ₹199 above ₹1,000) + GST; at most 5 rental transactions in 30 days (MITC 3(e))
No fee on third-party wallet loads up to ₹2,000; 1% + GST above ₹2,000, at most ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(f))

1% + GST on education paid through third-party sites and apps (CRED, PhonePe, Housing.com, NoBroker, CheQ etc.), capped at ₹5,000 per calendar month; direct school/college site, POS and international education payments are not charged (MITC 3(g))
1% + GST when one toll/transport transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹50,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(j))
1% + GST when one transaction exceeds ₹30,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹80,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(k))

reward_redemption_fee.notes: MITC 3(l): ₹100 + GST per redemption request regardless of points; ₹99 + GST convenience fee on flight bookings through points. Not applicable on cards without reward points.

components: 100% of GST + EMI amount + membership/rental/wallet fees + any amount over the credit limit
plus the higher of (finance charges + other fees + 2% of retail/cash outstanding) or ₹200 (MITC 6, KFS)

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Current Zagg card: zero first-year and zero renewal fee (page, MITC NIL / NIL). Cards issued before 10 Jan 2025 carry a ₹399 + GST annual fee waived on annual spends of ₹1,80,000 (page footnote, MITC).

conditions.rule: Spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous calendar quarter to unlock access in the next quarter; not available in the quarter of issuance; spends exclude fees, reversals, rent and wallet
conditions.booking: Lounge One web access or card swipe

open_questions: HELD: no reward rate for the current card is published. Re-read in wave 3 (W11, 2026-11-07): the product page, its Top Benefits slider (earn cashbacks, works everywhere, 1-click controls on the app, scan and pay for UPI: all images with headline text only), the What-comes-with-the-card items (lifetime free, works everywhere, 1% fuel surcharge waiver, lounge), the 7 FAQs, the usage guide, MITC V18 (the "English" MITC link on the page resolves to it; no Zagg or Rio coin terms in it) and the Cardmember Agreement state no cashback or coin rate. The only rate is the footnote for cards issued before 10 Jan 2025 (0.5 Rio coins per ₹50 on non-UPI and 1.5 Rio coins per ₹50 on UPI, outside exclusion categories). The page says any programme run by the Zagg app is the app provider's sole responsibility, so the current cashback programme sits outside YES documents. The value of a Rio coin is not stated. No reward rules are written. To unblock: ask YES BANK or Zagg for the Zagg card rewards terms.

Network (settled 2026-11-07, W11): RuPay, from card art on YES BANK's own Zagg pages (the usage guide PDF, the hero banner and the Top Benefits slide all show "YES BANK" and the RuPay logo). The product FAQ also says the card links to UPI apps ("NPCI recognised TPAPs"). The MITC and KFS do not name the network.

RIO and Zagg: the issuer lists one product. The page assets are named "rio_*" and the pre-10-Jan-2025 footnote speaks of Rio coins, so Rio is the earlier name of the same card; the old co-brand MITC (undated Mizo translation) lists "Rio" and the current MITC lists "Zagg". Treated as one card.
Lounge: two domestic visits a calendar quarter (page, listing) with a ₹50,000 prior-quarter spend condition (MITC 3(r), Lounge Program). Whether any international lounge access exists is not stated.
Fuel surcharge waiver: from 15 Jun 2026 ₹400 to ₹5,000 and ₹250 per statement cycle (MITC 4, KFS); the page glossary says the cap is ₹250 and states no range. No waiver on UPI fuel transactions.
notes: Forex mark-up is 3.50% (MITC and KFS list Zagg with BYOC / EMI / Wellness / Novio / Max).
The Zagg usage guide PDF is a single image page with no extractable text.

value.rule: 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement; nothing if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is ₹500 or less
value.note: A percentage fee cannot be written as fixed slabs, so late_payment_slabs is empty.

rules: Late payment charge: no charge if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is up to ₹500; above ₹500, 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement (MITC 3(b), KFS).

Auto-debit / payment return failure: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹500 whichever is higher on the net payable amount, capped at ₹5,000 per customer per statement (before that 2% or ₹450, cap ₹1,500); cheque return ₹450 (MITC 3(d)).
Overlimit: ₹550 + GST per transaction that exceeds the limit (facility reintroduced 1 Jun 2026) (MITC 3(c)).

Cash advance: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹650 whichever is higher; before that 2.5% or ₹500; not applicable to virtual cards; cash withdrawal suspended for the first 6 months after onboarding; limit up to 30% of the credit limit (MITC 3(a), 5).
